page.title: HTTP
page.findRoute: Find a route, handler or component
page.tracedTitle: Of all the calls the handlers make into code whose type could be told, the share the trace followed
page.modeRoutesTitle: Every route by its path, with who may call it and what it reaches
page.modeFlowTitle: What the routes reach, in lanes from handler to tables and systems
page.modeContractTitle: OpenAPI contracts against the routes, and the API design rules
page.modeOutboundTitle: Every system the code calls, per environment
page.reading: Reading routes, contracts and outbound calls…
page.predatesText: Routes are read from engine revision 13 on. Scan the workspace again to see them.
page.noRoutesText: No HTTP route, client or connection was found in this workspace's own code. Tests and vendored code are left out.
page.scanAgain: This snapshot has routes only. Scan again to read contracts, the trace from each route and the systems the code calls.
page.reachesTitle: What the route's handler reaches through the calls the trace could follow
page.nothingSaysLong: Nothing in the code says: no mark on the handler or its class, no middleware, no security rule that covers this path.
page.notInContractTitle: A contract covers this route's component but does not describe this route
page.accessNote: Read from the handler's marks, its class and base classes, middleware, and security configuration; empty when nothing says.
page.unitsNote: Units the trace reached from the handler. Calls on a variable whose type could not be told are not followed.
page.documentedAnnotations: Described by annotations for a generated contract
page.documentedFramework: Described by the framework, which publishes its own contract
page.traceShare: {resolved} of {sites} call sites followed; {unknown} on a receiver whose type could not be told.
page.selectReachedTitle: Select the components the routes reach, to make a group of them
page.noFlowText: Pick a route, a path prefix or a system, or clear the search.
page.flowFirst: What the first {count} of {total} routes reach. Pick a prefix or a route to narrow it.
page.noContractsText: No OpenAPI 3 or Swagger 2 document was found, and no route breaks a design rule that can be read from its path. A contract generated at run time (springdoc, Swashbuckle) is not a file and is not read.
page.providedWords: {matched} of {total} operations answered by a route; {specOnly} without one; {codeOnly} routes in the same components it does not describe.
page.consumedWords: A client is generated from this contract: {count} operations the code can call.
page.routeRules: Routes and the API design rules
page.routeRulesText: Routes under /api, or in a component a contract covers, checked against the NLGov REST API Design Rules that can be read from a path.
page.routesReachingTitle: Routes whose trace reaches a call to this system
page.configOnlyTitle: Named in configuration; no call in the code was found
page.hostNote: One row per environment, from configuration file names and folders; empty is every environment.
page.callsNote: Call sites in the workspace's own code; an unresolved one names a call whose address could not be followed.
page.selfCalls: Calls to this workspace's own routes
page.selfCallsText: A call whose path matches a route here: a frontend calling its backend, or one scanned service calling another.
page.confidenceTitle: declared: a client interface says it; resolved: the address was followed to a host; partial: a configuration key or name, no host; unresolved: the address could not be followed
page.flowPrefixFirst: What the first {count} of the {total} routes under {prefix} reach. Pick a deeper prefix or a route to narrow it.

flowLanes.ariaLabel: Lanes from routes to handlers, services, data and systems
flowLanes.lanesNote: A unit is in Data and clients when it touches stored data or calls out, or its name says so (Repository, Dao, Client); otherwise in Services.
flowLanes.countNote: The number on a box is how many of the routes reach it. Each lane shows the most-reached first.
